First release of the PC viewer for Windows and Linux.

Added
-----

* Windows and Linux viewers that find the console by themselves, or connect by IP.
* Connection over the local network or a USB-C cable, with consoles listed by their name.
* 1080p streams from the Switch 1080p mode.
* Image modes: Sharp, Smooth, AMD FidelityFX FSR 1 and, on Windows, Super Resolution for NVIDIA RTX and Intel GPUs.
* Extra sharpening.
* Volume and mute for NXStream only, without touching the system volume.
* Automatic reconnection when the console restarts, sleeps or loses Wi-Fi.
* Optional Discord status with the game you are playing.
* Statistics overlay with F3.
* Automatic updates for the PC viewer, asked at every start.
* FFmpeg built into the Windows exe and the Linux AppImage.
